title: Define runtime state directory and permission validation
purpose: Define how packaged AgentOS validates persistent run, audit, rollback, and memory directories before promotion.
scope: Define directory creation, owner, mode, persistence, and runtime authority expectations.
Define secret-safety checks for run state, audit projection, rollback handles, and memory.
Define restart-survival validation for state directories.
Define how permission evidence is written into Alpha promotion evidence.
acceptance_criteria: No raw secret values are allowed in state, audit, rollback metadata, or memory.
Only the runtime authority can write persistent state.
verification: Confirm permissions are concrete enough for later script validation.
Confirm audit projection can read latest and explicit run IDs.
risk_notes: Bad state permissions turn runtime recovery into best-effort file scraping instead of an OS contract.
implementation_steps: Translate runtime state contract into rootfs directory expectations.
Define restart-survival and no-secret validation cases.
Link validation outputs to future QEMU and provenance gates.
failure_modes: Audit and rollback paths are temporary only.
Memory path accepts untrusted or secret-like content without labels.
Recovery cannot distinguish run-store truth from audit truth.

verification_matrix.expected: All persistent state paths are defined
